subject: SOC2 evidence request — targeted MFA & auth log extracts (Jul–Dec 2025)
body:
From: Sara Li <sara@medivault.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted authn evidence (audit period Jul 1–December 31, 2025)

Hi Naomi,

Kestrel Audit LLP is starting our SOC 2 Type II review for Medivault and has asked us to collect a few items from Redwood to complete the control testing for the authentication/authz family of controls. Can you confirm that Redwood can provide the following for the audit period July 1–December 31, 2025?

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted PDF) and a short bridge letter describing no control changes affecting authn/authz since the report period
- Representative authn log slices (CSV) for 7 sample days across the period (we will specify exact days but prefer spread across Jul/Sep/Dec) including: timestamp (UTC), user_id (pseudonymized), auth_result, auth_method (password, SSO, mfa), device_type, and a session_id
- MFA evidence: enrollment lists (date enrolled), rotation/change events, and a summary of the MFA enforcement policy during the period
- Access review outputs for privileged/admin roles (recertification exports) dated inside the audit window

Please let us know: 1) whether these items are available, 2) any constraints (PII/IP data redaction, format limits), and 3) an estimated delivery date or staging plan. Our auditor will need a secure transfer method (SFTP/Box/Drive with restricted access).

Thanks — aim to have initial confirmation before EOD tomorrow if possible.

Best,
Sara Li
Senior Compliance Manager
Medivault Health

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@medivault.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted authn evidence (audit period Jul 1–Dec 31, 2025)

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. I can confirm we will support this request; I am looping in our security and solutions leads to scope the extraction and confirm redaction rules.

High-level plan:
- I will provide the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and a draft bridge letter for your review.
- Our security team will prepare the authn log slices with PII pseudonymized; we will provide a manifest of fields and sample row format before delivery.
- For MFA and access-review artifacts we will provide exported CSVs and a short runbook explaining collection methodology.

Next steps: I'll introduce Jonas (security) and Aditya (solutions) who will confirm the exact field list and an ETA — aiming to have a secure upload link and first artifacts by Friday (Aug 6).

Attaching a draft bridge letter for reference.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: soc2_bridge_letter_draft.pdf (stub)

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted authn evidence (Medivault)

Jonas / Aditya — forwarding Medivault's ask below. Key points: audit period = 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31; they want 7 sample days + MFA enrollment/rotation events + privileged access recert exports.

Can you confirm:
1) which exact fields we can include in the authn slices (we need to be explicit about IPs, tokens, and PII)
2) pseudonymization approach (hashing vs token mapping) and whether we can provide a consistent pseudonym across slices for linking sessions
3) expected turnaround if we stage delivery to a secure Box folder (we have an IR role to upload and provide link)

Please respond with ETA by EOD tomorrow (Tue Aug 4) so I can close the loop with Sara.

Thanks,
Naomi

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@medivault.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted authn evidence (audit period Jul 1–Dec 31, 2025)

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and Naomi for the intro. I'm the lead for security evidence exports; below is what we can commit to and a few constraints.

What we will provide:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted PDF) and a signed bridge letter confirming there were no control changes affecting authentication/authz for the stated period.
- Authn log slices for 7 sample days. Proposed sample days (we can adjust if Kestrel requests alternatives): 2025-07-02, 2025-08-21, 2025-09-15, 2025-10-10, 2025-11-06, 2025-11-27, 2025-12-20.
- Fields in the CSV slices: timestamp_utc, pseudonymized_user_id, auth_result (success/failure), auth_method, mfa_flag (true/false), device_type, session_id, account_id (pseudonymized), event_id. We will include a header row and a sample row in the manifest.
- MFA evidence: enrollment export (user_id pseudonymized, enrolled_at), MFA change events (user_id, event, timestamp).
- Access review exports: privileged_role, user_id (pseudonymized), last_review_date, reviewer, decision (retain/remove), evidence CSVs for recert cycles conducted in the window.

Redaction and data handling constraints:
- We will pseudonymize user identifiers using a salted hash; the same salt will be used consistently across all slices so sessions can be correlated, but we cannot provide the mapping to original user emails (auditor understands this model).
- We will remove raw IP addresses and OAuth tokens from the slices.
- We will include session-level event_ids to support traceability without exposing PII.
- Any exported data will be placed in a restricted Box folder (or SFTP if Medivault prefers); we will provide credentials to Kestrel for one-time download.

Timeline / deliverables:
- Today (Aug 4): I'll upload the manifest describing fields and a sample CSV row to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-auth-extracts
- Aug 6 EOD: full initial package (redacted SOC 2, bridge letter, 3 of 7 authn day slices, MFA enrollment CSV, access review exports).
- Aug 10: remaining 4 authn day slices and any follow-up extracts requested by Kestrel.

Attachment: auth_logs_manifest.csv (stub) — contains column list and a sample row format.

Notes / asks for Medivault / Kestrel:
- Please confirm the preferred secure transfer method (Box vs SFTP) and whether Kestrel wants direct access or Medivault will download and re-upload.
- Confirm whether Kestrel requires any additional PII redaction (e.g., device identifiers) beyond what we've specified.

If that works I'll proceed with the manifest upload now and queue the extraction job.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

---

From: Sara Li <sara@medivault.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted authn evidence (audit period Jul 1–Dec 31, 2025)

Hi Jonas — this plan looks good and the proposed redaction approach is acceptable to Kestrel. We prefer Box for the transfer; Medivault will give Kestrel a single, time-limited download link after we verify receipt.

A couple of small asks:
- Please include timezone info (timestamps in UTC are fine) and a short README describing the pseudonymization salt approach (high level, not the key itself).
- If possible, prioritize the MFA enrollment export and the July/December slices in the first upload.

We will countersign the DPA that Naomi mentioned (I'll send it to legal). Once Kestrel confirms they can access the Box link we'll mark the items received.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Sara
Senior Compliance Manager
Medivault Health
